title: Bramley Apple Stew
description: A hearty and comforting stew made with tender Bramley apples, perfect for a chilly evening.
instructions: 1. Peel, core and chop the Bramley apples into chunks.
2. If using stewing steak, cut it into bite-sized pieces and season with salt and pepper.
3. In a large pot or Dutch oven, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
4. Add the chopped apples and sauté for 5 minutes, until they start to soften.
5. Add the stewing steak (if using) and cook for a further 2-3 minutes.
6. Pour in the stewing liquid and bring the mixture to a simmer.
7. Reduce the heat to low and let the stew cook for 30-40 minutes, or until the apples are tender.
8. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
